correctness.rationale: The eventual-constant condition is reduced exactly to k boundary sign equations plus a unique tail recursion. The coefficient vectors have one bounded transition column and two positive-density families, yielding covariance (kI+(k+2)J)/k^2, determinant (k+3)/k^k, and full even-lattice span. Fourier inversion has exactly 2^k equal major arcs; the resulting multivariate Gaussian transform gives both the leading constant and the square-root-scale offset factor. Exact finite dynamic-programming checks independently verify the coefficient construction and representative counts.

originality.rationale: Li--Xu--Yan (arXiv:2609.20385) prove only two-sided order bounds F_{k,c}(T) asymptotic up to constants. Searches for exact asymptotic constants, local-limit formulations, Gaussian offset profiles, f_k(t), R_{1,k}(A,n), and equivalent weighted-representation terminology found no prior statement of the constant (8k/pi)^(k/2)/sqrt(k+3) or the c_T/sqrt(T) profile. The 2012 Yang--Chen full text was not independently inspected, and the 2026 source is very recent, so originality remains to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result upgrades a newly proved order of magnitude to a full asymptotic for every fixed k, sharpens cross-weight comparisons to an asymptotic ratio, and identifies the natural square-root fluctuation scale with an explicit Gaussian profile.
